completeness.why: copyPreviousMonth passes its rows to isMonthFillCategory with 'copyable'; setZero and the three averages take their category set from getMonthFillCategories with 'all'/'visible' (no local SQL filter or income check remains); both sign inversions go through toBudgetedAverage. Each site only passes its data plus a named scope that encodes the preserved inconsistency.

interface.why: A single scope parameter ('all' | 'visible' | 'copyable') carries exactly the real variation, including the preserved setZero and missing-group inconsistencies, documented in a comment; the average sign is a small function and the three averages share setMonthAverage by month count, with no speculative options.

disguised_duplication.where: The four category filters and two sign inversions are removed and replaced by calls to the shared definitions; nothing is left duplicated in another shape.
